exercises.question: Which sentence locates a place with a relative clause? [¿Cuál localiza un lugar con una oración de relativo?]
options: La calle donde vivo está cerca de una estación. [The street where I live is near a station.]
La calle está cerca de una estación. [The street is near a station.]
Vivo cerca de una estación. [I live near a station.]

exercises.sentence: La calle __ vivo está cerca de una estación. (donde) [The street where I live is near a station.]

exercises.english: There is a square where the neighbours meet.

sentences: Vivo en un barrio que tiene una plaza tranquila. [I live in a neighbourhood that has a quiet square.]
La plaza está cerca de mi casa. [The square is near my home.]
Los vecinos se reúnen allí los domingos. [The neighbours meet there on Sundays.]

exercises.question: Which form completes «Hay una plaza en la que los vecinos ___ los domingos»? [¿Qué forma completa la frase?]
options: se reúnen [meet]
se reunirán [will meet]
se reunían ayer [used to meet yesterday]

exercises.sentence: El edificio que está al final de la calle está __ junto al parque. (ubicado) [The building at the end of the street is located next to the park.]
Vivo en un barrio que tiene una plaza muy tranquila.
options: I live in a neighbourhood that has a very quiet square.
I lived in a neighbourhood that had a very noisy square.
I am looking for a neighbourhood without a square.

exercises.sentence: La calle donde vivo está cerca de una estación.
options: The street where I live is near a station.
The street where I work is far from a station.
The street where I lived was next to a park.

exercises.sentence: Hay una plaza en la que los vecinos se reúnen los domingos.
El edificio que está al final de la calle está ubicado junto al parque.
options: The building at the end of the street is located next to the park.
The building near the park was moved to the end of the street.
The park is located inside the building.
Es un barrio que tiene una plaza donde los vecinos se reúnen. [It is a neighbourhood that has a square where the neighbours meet.]
Es un barrio que tiene una plaza donde se reunirán ayer. [It is a neighbourhood that has a square where they will meet yesterday.]
Es un barrio donde tiene una plaza y los vecinos. [It is a neighbourhood where it has a square and the neighbours.]
Está en una calle que está ubicada junto al parque. [It is on a street that is located next to the park.]
Está en una calle donde está ubicada el parque ayer. [It is on a street where the park was located yesterday.]
Está en una calle que estará ubicada junto al parque mañana. [It is on a street that will be located next to the park tomorrow.]
Sí, hay una plaza en la que podemos reunirnos los domingos. [Yes, there is a square where we can meet on Sundays.]
Sí, hay una plaza en la que reuniremos ayer. [Yes, there is a square where we will meet yesterday.]
Sí, hay una plaza donde tiene reuniones los domingos. [Yes, there is a square where it has meetings on Sundays.]

template.prompt: Describe your neighbourhood using one relative clause.
template.answer: Vivo en un barrio que tiene una plaza tranquila y está cerca del centro.

template.prompt: Describe one local place and say where it is.
template.answer: Hay una plaza donde los vecinos se reúnen, aunque está bastante cerca del tráfico.
